name: Datamuse API
summary: Word-finding API: synonyms, rhymes, meaning-like, sounds-like, autocomplete and word frequency.
description: Query by meaning (ml), sounds like (sl), spelled like (sp), rhyme (rel_rhy), related words and more, with frequency and part-of-speech tags. Also offers /sug for autocomplete. Built on language corpora and word vectors.

rate_limit.summary: 100,000 requests/day per IP without a key (documented).

endpoints.summary: Find words by meaning, sound, spelling or relation

license.name: Free for commercial and noncommercial use; attribution requested, no formal open license

agent_notes: Constraints such as ml, sp and rel_rhy can be combined in one call. Add md=dpf to get definitions, parts of speech and frequency. Spanish results need the v=es parameter.
caveats: High-volume commercial use requires contacting Datamuse.

hn.title: Datamuse API: a word-finding query engine for developers
